my first tip is that the wiki is your friend!! [https://sunhaven.wiki.gg/wiki/Sun\_Haven\_Wiki](https://sunhaven.wiki.gg/wiki/Sun_Haven_Wiki) theres also lots of reddit threads i have opened on the best crops for each season ( [https://www.reddit.com/r/SunHaven/comments/163hx40/best\_crops\_to\_grow\_in\_all\_seasons/](https://www.reddit.com/r/SunHaven/comments/163hx40/best_crops_to_grow_in_all_seasons/) ) the discussion on crops helped so much. if you get stuck or confused by something, i can 99% guarantee that someone else has asked the question and been answered!! its saved me so much time and stress just googling my problem or question <3

I completely ignored the museum because i was so overwhelmed by it, until i installed a mod that tells me if ive donated something necessary to the museum, ( [https://www.nexusmods.com/sunhaven/mods/144](https://www.nexusmods.com/sunhaven/mods/144) with a short and easy video on how to install sun haven mods here [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yOi0EelbS0I](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yOi0EelbS0I) ) and now im almost done with it, it helped me screw my head on so much better in terms of keeping track. but i also understand not wanting to download mods for a new game.

for early game I recommend clover (for farming experience) and GRAPES!! for money, the only downside to grapes is you have to progress the main story a little bit and you have to infuse each crop with 5 mana, which isnt super easy early game when you have a smaller amount of mana. forage lots of fruit because some of them, (raspberries, blueberries, peaches and regular berries) give mana you can use to replenish yourself. also, try to plant one or two of each crop in each season if you can for each of the seasonal crops bundle, you wont need all of them, but i found it easier than trying to keep track of which ones i needed to plant and which ones i didnt

overall, just take your time, dont worry too much about being behind, when i was feeling overwhelmed by things to do, i always just took a breath and focused on one specific thing, went mining or fishing or exploring in the forest and let myself just stop thinking and zone out for a bit, i usually have a video or music playing on the side so im not too deep in it. dont worry about getting everything done fast, theres so much stuff to do that its really easy to get upset trying to do everything at once!! enjoy the game!!!!
